description: This is a utility function for inferring columns for a DataTable component based on a dataset, with support for allowlist filtering and special handling for date fields.

methods.name: inferColumns(rows = [], allowlist = [], options = {})
methods.description: Given rows of data, an allowlist of fields, and optional configurations, returns an array of column definitions suitable for rendering a DataTable. It filters the fields based on their presence in the data and allowlist, and formats date fields specially.
